subject: I wish I could post some

body:
I wish I could post some Proof, but apparently since I closed the Paradise Forums before, LOL.. (I was the last person I think to have posted LOL, and Kevlar is super proof of that and a witness to the testament of my ability to close forums down) .. I havent been able to scrounge up some dirt on Revenge 2.

However a few credible "shadowy underground" Sources have stated that Rofer is creating a Revenge 2 with the best cars given to only 15 of the top racers in the world. LOL.. and that a certain dude who posted "Hes too Fast!" is making some company built on getting our Name Tags on the back of a Black or White T-shirt and Customized to say Revenge Elite.. 

Apparently he's some Mexican kid who looks like another Mexican kid we all know and love. 

Another "Wazted" Source tells me that Revenge 3 is coming out the same day as Revenge 2. Except this time around, we wont be seeing it because the demo is only 0.0001% done.. Maybe when its 1% complete we might actually get to see it a few years after 2?

Does that satisfy your need to be a "Happy" Woman? Because it sure satisfied my need to create a Parodied Story.. LOL..
